highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 previews Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and GPU rendering corrections.
highlights_body: The cumulative line also corrects generated LibraryImport calling conventions without changing public managed APIs. Later collected fixes improve transformed geometry, clip capacity, displacement precision and native Vulkan synchronization; the preview history below identifies what shipped in each cut.

breaking.title: Check the Graphite Metal runtime minimum
breaking.body: Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise the deployment target when using this backend on older iOS or tvOS targets, and continue to satisfy any higher managed or framework minimum.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 157 while preserving the existing managed API surface and the fork's glyph-bounds guard. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without upgrading the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

Fixes a convex anti-aliased path heap overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and convex-path device-space bounds. Direct-mask Slug replay gains validation for unsupported fractional replay, deserialization and drawing.

bullets.lead: Correct GPU geometry and atlas selection
bullets.detail: Reflected zero-length square-capped hairlines keep the correct scale. Text atlas indices are rounded before sampler selection; ellipse and rounded-rectangle transforms use the correct axes and clamp corner radii. Ganesh also avoids stale atlas work after empty flushes.

Corrects clip-key packing, wedge inflation and alpha-to-RGBx GPU-to-CPU transfer stride. Clip recording accounts for undrawn clips and warns and skips a draw whose full clip stack cannot fit a fresh render pass.

Affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but excluding, 56 get a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay. Native synchronous submission propagates fence-wait failure, but GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offsets now use float precision to match filter bounds.

Generated LibraryImport declarations explicitly use cdecl across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, SceneGraph, Skottie and Resources, matching existing DllImport and delegate paths. This addresses the ABI mismatch implicated in Windows x86 stack growth; that runtime symptom still awaits platform-specific validation.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection. It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later, subject to any higher framework minimum.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching its existing interop paths. This corrects calling-convention metadata without changing the public API or native exports.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing the native HarfBuzz version. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later, in addition to any higher framework requirements.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and GPU text-atlas selection.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers. These fixes do not change managed APIs.
